risks.title: Incomplete market data affecting projections
risks.description: Market research may have gaps leading to flawed financial projections and business decisions
risks.treatmentPlan: Use multiple data sources, conduct sensitivity analysis, validate with industry experts

risks.title: Regulatory compliance gaps
risks.description: Gaps in regulatory compliance for Pakistan, US, and EU operations
risks.treatmentPlan: Engage legal counsel early, conduct compliance audits, establish policy framework

risks.title: HEKTOR timeline slippage
risks.description: 18-month HEKTOR implementation may face delays due to complexity or resourcing
risks.treatmentPlan: Hire aggressively, track milestones closely, accept some technical debt for speed

risks.title: Technology stack revision needed
risks.description: Technology stack selection may need revision as requirements evolve
risks.treatmentPlan: Build modular architecture, maintain flexibility, regular technology reviews

risks.title: Competition from hyperscalers
risks.description: AWS, Azure, GCP may compete directly in target markets
risks.treatmentPlan: Focus on specialization, service quality, and local market knowledge

risks.title: Key personnel dependency
risks.description: Over-reliance on key technical and business personnel
risks.treatmentPlan: Document all processes, cross-train team members, develop succession plans

risks.title: Power reliability (Pakistan)
risks.description: Power supply unreliability in Pakistan may affect data center operations
risks.treatmentPlan: Install robust UPS, backup generators with 72-hour fuel, dual power feeds

risks.title: Currency fluctuations
risks.description: PKR/USD exchange rate fluctuations affecting revenue and costs
risks.treatmentPlan: Operate in multiple currencies, implement hedging where appropriate
